b2-gimnaziumok-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Fasori Classroom
b2-gimnaziumok-01.scenario: At a history-of-science evening in Budapest, a visitor asks how Rátz László taught at the Fasori gimnázium and what he did for the young Neumann János.
b2-gimnaziumok-01.prompt: Tell him how Rátz taught the formulas and what he arranged for Neumann's education.
cues: Say how Rátz did not teach the formulas
Say who taught the young Neumann besides the school
b2-gimnaziumok-01.target: Rátz László nem magoltatta be a képleteket, hanem a legtehetségesebb diákokkal vezettette le az új tételeket. Neumann János édesapját meggyőzte, hogy egyetemi tanárokkal taníttassák a fiát.
b2-gimnaziumok-01.english: László Rátz did not have the formulas learned by heart; he had the most talented pupils derive the new theorems. He convinced Neumann's father to have his son taught by university professors.
b2-gimnaziumok-01.canDo: I can explain how László Rátz and Sándor Mikola taught scientific talent at the Fasori Gimnázium.

b2-gimnaziumok-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Minta Gimnázium
b2-gimnaziumok-02.scenario: On the open day of the Trefort utca school, a guest asks what Kármán Mór changed in the training of teachers.
b2-gimnaziumok-02.prompt: Tell her what the trainee teachers did and what Kármán had them do after the lessons.
cues: Say where the trainee teachers were put
Say what Kármán had them analyse
b2-gimnaziumok-02.target: Kármán Mór a tanárjelölteket azonnal a katedrára állította, majd közösen elemeztette velük a megtartott órákat. A Minta Gimnázium a magyar tanárképzés fontos műhelye lett.
b2-gimnaziumok-02.english: Mór Kármán put the trainee teachers straight onto the teacher's dais, then had them analyse the lessons they had given together. The Minta Gimnázium became an important workshop of Hungarian teacher training.
b2-gimnaziumok-02.canDo: I can describe how Mór Kármán built the Minta Gimnázium as a training school for Hungarian teachers.

b2-gimnaziumok-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Ménesi Road Collegium
b2-gimnaziumok-03.scenario: At the Eötvös Collegium, a student guide is asked what the state did for the college and where the graduates went.
b2-gimnaziumok-03.prompt: Tell the visitor what the state had built and where the ministry sent the graduates.
cues: Say what the state had built, and where
Say where the ministry sent the graduates
b2-gimnaziumok-03.target: Az állam a Ménesi úton impozáns épületet emeltetett a Collegium számára. A minisztérium a végzetteket vidéki gimnáziumokba helyeztette.
b2-gimnaziumok-03.english: The state had an imposing building erected on Ménesi Road for the Collegium. The ministry had the graduates placed in provincial gimnáziums.
b2-gimnaziumok-03.canDo: I can explain how and why the Eötvös József Collegium was founded in 1895.

b2-gimnaziumok-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Church, State and Alternative Schools
b2-gimnaziumok-04.scenario: At a history lesson in a Budapest school, the teacher asks you what happened to the church schools in 1948 and what the alternative schools allowed.
b2-gimnaziumok-04.prompt: Tell the teacher what the authorities did in 1948 and what the alternative schools let pupils do.
cues: Say what the authorities had done by 1948
Say what the alternative schools let pupils do
b2-gimnaziumok-04.target: 1948-ban a hatalom államosíttatta a felekezeti iskolák többségét. Az alternatív iskolák engedték, hogy a diákok egyéni tanulási utakat válasszanak.
b2-gimnaziumok-04.english: In 1948 the authorities had most of the denominational schools nationalised. The alternative schools allowed pupils to choose individual learning paths.
b2-gimnaziumok-04.canDo: I can describe how Hungarian church, state and alternative schools changed from Pannonhalma and Sárospatak to the 1990s.

b2-gimnaziumok-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Eight-Year Gimnáziums
b2-gimnaziumok-05.scenario: At a parents' evening in Budapest, a teacher asks you what the debate about the eight-year gimnáziums is about.
b2-gimnaziumok-05.prompt: Tell her what the schools do at age ten and who can afford to have children prepared.
cues: Say what the schools do at age ten
Say which families can have children prepared
b2-gimnaziumok-05.target: A nyolcosztályos gimnáziumok már tízéves korban felvételiztetik a diákokat. A tehetősebb családok magántanárokkal készíttethetik fel a gyerekeiket.
b2-gimnaziumok-05.english: Eight-year gimnáziums give entrance exams to pupils as early as age ten. Better-off families can have their children prepared by private tutors.
b2-gimnaziumok-05.canDo: I can talk about today's debate on six- and eight-year gimnáziumok, olympiads and equal opportunity.

b2-gimnaziumok-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Elite Schools of Hungary
b2-gimnaziumok-consolidation.scenario: At a talk in Budapest on the history of elite schools, a listener asks who had what done for the talented pupils.
b2-gimnaziumok-consolidation.prompt: Tell him what Neumann's father had done and what the state had built for the Collegium.
cues: Say who had Neumann taught by whom
Say what the state had built for the Collegium
b2-gimnaziumok-consolidation.target: Neumann János édesapja egyetemi tanárokkal taníttatta a fiát. Az állam új épületet emeltetett az Eötvös Collegiumnak.
b2-gimnaziumok-consolidation.english: János Neumann's father had his son taught by university professors. The state had a new building erected for the Eötvös Collegium.
b2-gimnaziumok-consolidation.canDo: I can explain the historical role of the Fasori Gimnázium, the Minta Gimnázium, and the Eötvös Collegium in Hungarian scientific and cultural achievements.
